I'm writing `E-agency-work-orders.md` now. I'll then link it from M-象-2000 next to the other related excursions.㊥ (E-agency-work-orders) I've written `futon3c/holes/excursions/E-agency-work-orders.md` and linked it from M-象-2000 as an attached excursion. Committed as `02a80b37`, not pushed yet. The excursion says a work order stays open until the agent that received it reports it done against its acceptance bar, or the agent that asked releases it. An agent whose job ends with an order still open gets a reminder. P24's `futon3c.logic.xiang` decides whether an order is open.

㊢ (contents) The excursion has:
- **Requirements:** an order is a recorded act; a job ending doesn't close it; one reminder at turn end, then a problem report to the agent that asked; the kernel is the only judge; a listing route plus a count in the lighter.
- **What already exists:** parking, promises and the obligations projection, all of which serve only the agent that asked.
- **The P24 gap:** delivered work isn't recorded as closing the obligation.

The order of work starts by turning the codex-19 case into a P24 fixture whose expected result is "still open after codex-19's job ends".

㊩ (the codex-19 case) I couldn't find it yet. codex-19's last 200 jobs include 27 bells from codex-19 to claude-4 and none from claude-4 to codex-19. claude-4's request may have travelled inside a reply. The excursion records this, and finding the case is its first task.

㊢ (step 1) kimi-1 is still working on step 1 (job `invoke-1791070032310-31301-c2a8b13a`). I'll review it when it bells back, before steps 2 and 3.
